# mbse-schemas

> Neutral, language-independent schemas for interfaces and data models: objects, relations whose entries carry properties, unions and intersections. One schema value drives in-memory objects, JSON and YAML, validation and comparison, with equivalent Python (`mbse.Schemas.Framework`) and TypeScript (`@mbse/schemas/Framework`) implementations that write byte-identical JSON. Aimed at model-based systems engineering (MBSE) and any interface several programs or languages must agree on.

Every collection is a relation (there are no list-valued properties), nothing is mandatory, validation runs only when asked, and native types are never coerced.

## Why

- [MBSE.md](https://github.com/pitaman71/mbse-schemas/blob/main/MBSE.md): executable specifications, and each mbse repository's part in them

## Using it

- [Agent skill](https://github.com/pitaman71/mbse-schemas/blob/main/skills/mbse-schemas/SKILL.md): when to use it, the rules that prevent most mistakes, and references loaded per task
- [Modeling guide](https://github.com/pitaman71/mbse-schemas/blob/main/skills/mbse-schemas/references/modeling.md): SysML, UML, ORM and JSON Schema concepts mapped to schema elements
- [Python](https://github.com/pitaman71/mbse-schemas/blob/main/skills/mbse-schemas/references/python.md) and [TypeScript](https://github.com/pitaman71/mbse-schemas/blob/main/skills/mbse-schemas/references/typescript.md): a complete program, cheat sheet and traps
- [Serialization](https://github.com/pitaman71/mbse-schemas/blob/main/skills/mbse-schemas/references/serialization.md): the snapshot format and strict decoding

## Design

- [FRAMEWORK.md](https://github.com/pitaman71/mbse-schemas/blob/main/docs/FRAMEWORK.md): every element, rule and decision, plus the open questions
- [EQUALITY.md](https://github.com/pitaman71/mbse-schemas/blob/main/docs/EQUALITY.md): equality, ordering and comparison under a schema

## Optional

- [Tutorial, Python](https://github.com/pitaman71/mbse-schemas/blob/main/python3/tutorials/README.md): nine case studies explaining the reasoning
- [Tutorial, TypeScript](https://github.com/pitaman71/mbse-schemas/blob/main/typescript5/tutorials/README.md): the same case studies
- [EQUIVALENCE.md](https://github.com/pitaman71/mbse-schemas/blob/main/docs/EQUIVALENCE.md): how the two implementations are kept identical
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/pitaman71/mbse-schemas/blob/main/AGENTS.md): for agents changing this repository
- [mbse-expressions](https://github.com/pitaman71/mbse-expressions): expressions for constraints
